svg.title: Runtime workload protocol
svg.desc: The primary matrix is 1/4/8/16/32 concurrent workers, three repeats, with AB/BA arm order alternating by repetition. Each cell uses a fresh disposable profile, one persistent tab per worker and one persistent socket per worker. The matched route uses identical WebKit read/fetch commands. The public-http route changes only candidate static/JSON retrieval to its public no-cookie/no-JavaScript HTTP path. Report that routing difference and report both matrices; do not present it as an engine-only speedup. Baseline already uses its best browser read/fetch commands rather than navigation plus unnecessarily repeated extraction.
